narrative.title: The Freight Yard Odd-Cargo Counter
narrative.scenario: A freight yard tracks wagons, flagging each as carrying odd-classified cargo (1) or not (0 in the parity log). A route segment is 'eventful' when exactly k wagons in it carry odd-classified cargo. The yard clerk needs the number of eventful segments — even-length gaps of even cargo are allowed to pad either side, so segments are counted by position, not by shape.
narrative.inputFormat: An integer array nums and an integer k.
narrative.outputFormat: Return the number of contiguous subarrays containing exactly k odd numbers.

testCases.explanation: Only [1,1,2,1] and [1,2,1,1] hold exactly three odd wagons.
No wagon carries odd cargo, so no segment can be eventful.
